message.content: {"skills":[{"name":"边最大车辆数计算","description":"按 MaxVehicles(edge) = LaneCount(edge) × CapacityPerLane(edge) 计算指定边的最大允许占用车辆数，作为准入校验的容量基准。","prompt":"给定一条边的 LaneCount(edge) 与 CapacityPerLane(edge)，计算 MaxVehicles(edge) = LaneCount(edge) × CapacityPerLane(edge)，输出该边的最大允许占用车辆数，作为后续准入校验的容量基准。若缺少任一参数，不要臆造数值，应报告参数缺失。","asset_type":"micro_skill","asset_node_id":"micro_skill_node","granularity":"micro","objective":"计算指定边的最大允许占用车辆数","domain":"交通仿真规则","task_family":"容量计算","method_family":"公式计算","stage":"capacity_evaluation","applicable_signals":["需要判断占用是否超限","需要边容量基准值"],"intervention_moves":["读取该边的 LaneCount(edge)","读取该边的 CapacityPerLane(edge)","按公式相乘得到 MaxVehicles(edge)"],"contraindications":["缺少车道数或每车道容量参数"],"triggers":["需要判断占用是否超限","需要边容量基准值"],"workflow_steps":["确认目标边并获取 LaneCount(edge) 与 CapacityPerLane(edge)","计算 MaxVehicles(edge) = LaneCount(edge) × CapacityPerLane(edge)","输出 MaxVehicles(edge) 数值，供准入校验使用"],"constraints":["必须使用公式 MaxVehicles(edge) = LaneCount(edge) × CapacityPerLane(edge)","缺少任一参数时不得臆造数值"],"cautions":["该结果仅作为容量基准，不替代准入判定逻辑"],"output_contract":["输出 MaxVehicles(edge) 数值"],"examples":[],"tags":["交通仿真","容量计算","边容量","准入校验"],"confidence":0.8,"risk_class":"low","support_ids":["785ae8a6-67f4-537b-ae58-fbd5281eae00"],"source_draft_ids":["efebe356-508e-5c1e-b685-9dc590ee435c"]}]}
